name: ai-for-managers-pack
description: 31 Claude Skills for running a team, from the first 1:1 to the hard conversation: difficult conversation prep, SBI feedback, PIPs, conflict resolution and return-to-work, the new manager 30-60-90 plan, 1:1 agendas and the manager README, levels of delegation, handoff notes, the RACI and the cross-training plan, capacity planning, the Eisenhower matrix, psychological safety checks and a team AI playbook, managing up briefs, skip-levels, change announcements and DACI decisions, team meeting agendas, working agreements and retrospectives, the team charter, team OKRs and SMART goals, GROW coaching, career conversations, IDPs, stay interviews and recognition notes.
